agenda_text:
City of Encinitas
San Dieguito Water District 5:00 p.m.
AGENDA
WEDNESDAY, OCTOBER 28, 2020 -
05:00 PM
p.m.
City of Encinitas - City Council Chambers
505 S. Vulcan Avenue
Encinitas, California 92024
Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the City Council.
S1.
CALL TO ORDER
San Dieguito Water District Board Members receive an independent stipend of $100 for convening the Water District meetings pursuant to San Dieguito Water District Resolution No. 89-07.
S2.
ROLL CALL
S3.
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE
S4.
SPECIAL PRESENTATIONS AND PROCLAMATIONS
S5.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS / POSSIBLE DIRECTION TO STAFF
(30 MINUTES)
Oral Communications will be accepted as outlined above under New Public Comment Procedures. Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the City Council. Oral Communication items will be referred to the General Manager either for resolution by administrative action or placement on a future agenda.
S6.
REPORT FROM CLOSED SESSION (IF HELD)
S7.
CHANGES TO THE AGENDA
Announcements of administrative changes to the agenda, in compliance with the Brown Act.
S8.
CONSENT CALENDAR
The recommendations on the following Consent Calendar will be enacted in one motion unless an item is removed from the Calendar. Public Comments will be accepted as outlined above under New Public Comment Procedures. Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the City Council. Items removed from the Consent Calendar by a Board Member or the public will be considered immediately following the Consent Calendar.
The title of ordinances listed on this agenda are deemed to have been read and further reading waived.
8A.
Approval of the Minutes of the August 26, 2020 Special Meeting- Closed Session; and the August 26, 2020 Regular Meeting. Contact Person: Board Clerk Hollywood
Approve the Minutes.
2020-10-28 SDWD Item S08A Minutes
8B.
Approval of the Warrants List. Contact Person: Finance Analyst McShane
Approve the Warrants List.
2020-10-28 SDWD Item S08B Warrants
8C.
Notice of Completion for City of Encinitas Tentative Map No. 15-064 710 Clark Avenue Public Water Improvements. Contact Person: Associate Civil Engineer Olson
1) Accept the public water improvements; and 2) Authorize the General Manager to file a Notice of Completion (Attachment 1 of the agenda report).
2020-10-28 SDWD Item S08C NOC 710 Clark Ave
8D.
Authorization to enter into a Professional Services Contract with Dudek to prepare As-Needed Professional Services for Design and Construction Task Orders. Contact Person: Senior Civil Engineer Knoll
Authorize the City Manager to execute a contract with Dudek in substantial form as included in Attachment 1 of the agenda report, in consultation with the City Attorney in the amount of $150,000 per year for a three-year term. Total contract amount not-to-exceed $450,000 without additional authorization.
2020-10-28 SDWD Item S08D As Needed Professional Services -Dudek
8E.
Quitclaim of Water Easements and Enter into an Access Agreement with San Elijo Joint Powers Authority Located at 2695 Manchester Avenue, Encinitas (APNs 261-010-13-01 and 261-010-13-02). Contact Person: Senior Civil Engineer Knoll
1) Adopt Resolution No. 2020-10, entitled “A Resolution of the Board of Directors of San Dieguito Water District Approving Quitclaim of Water Easements on 2695 Manchester Avenue, Encinitas (APNs 261-010-13-01 and 261-010-13-02)” (Attachment 2 of the agenda report); 2) Authorize the General Manager to file a Quitclaim Deed of Public Water Easement (Attachment 3 of the agenda report); 3) Authorize the General Manager to file a Release Encroachment Permit (Attachment 4 of the agenda report); and 4) Authorize the City Manager and General Manager to enter into an Access Agreement with the San Elijo Joint Powers Authority (Attachment 5 of the agenda report).
2020-10-28 SDWD Item S08E SEJPA 2695 Manchester Quitclaim
8F.
Notice of Completion for Scripps Health Encinitas Memorial North Parking 326 Santa Fe Drive Public Water Improvements. Contact Person: Associate Civil Engineer Olson
1) Accept the public water improvements; and 2) Authorize the General Manager to file a Notice of Completion (Attachment 1 of the agenda report).
2020-10-28 SDWD Item S08F NOC Scripps 326 Santa Fe Dr
8G.
Third Amendment to the Agreement for the sale of Reclaimed Water with the San Elijo Joint Powers Authority. Contact Person: Senior Civil Engineer Knoll
Authorize the City Manager and General Manager to enter into a Third Amendment to the Agreement for the Sale of Reclaimed Water with the San Elijo Joint Powers Authority.
2020-10-28 SDWD Item S08G Third Amendment for the Sale of Reclaimed Water - SEJPA
S9.
ITEMS REMOVED FROM THE CONSENT CALENDAR
Staff reports will be given only if requested by the person who pulled the item.
S10.
ACTION ITEMS
Public Comments will be accepted as outlined above under New Public Comment Procedures. Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the Board.
10A.
Authorization to enter into a Professional Services Contract with Raftelis Financial
Consultants, Inc., to perform a District Water Rate Cost of Service Study. Contact Person: Finance Manager Kazungu
Authorize the General Manager to enter into a contact with Raftelis Financial Consultants, Inc., in the amount of $51,516 plus a 10 percent staff-authorized contingency of $5,152 for a total contact cost of $56,668, to conduct the District’s Water Rate Cost of Service Study.
2020-10-28 SDWD Item S10A Water Rate Study Agreement
S11.
INFORMATIONAL ITEMS
11A.
Update on Lake Hodges Dam. Contact Person: General Manager Quiram
S13.
GENERAL INFORMATION / STAFF STATUS REPORTS
13A.
General Manager Update/Report
S12.
BOARD MEMBER REPORTS PURSUANT TO AB1234 (GC 53232.3(d)) / POSSIBLE DIRECTION TO STAFF
S14.
ADJOURNMENT - THE NEXT REGULAR BOARD MEETING WILL BE HELD ON NOVEMBER 18, 2020
Notice to the Public:
To ensure that the City meets your needs when addressing the City Council, all presentation materials which require the use of visual equipment need to be submitted to the City's IT Division at least 24 hours in advance of the meeting (except for appeal hearings where materials must be submitted 7 days in advance). This includes photographs, Microsoft Office documents (PowerPoint, Word, Excel). No CD's, DVD's, or USB thumb/flash drives will be accepted at the meeting. All materials must be in PC format and digital presentation items must be emailed to it-service-desk@encinitasca.gov . Please label all materials with the corresponding agenda item number. Should technical assistance be necessary, it will be available to presenters from 5:30 p.m. to 5:50 p.m. on the day of the meeting. Presentation of video/digital/photographs are considered part of the maximum time limit provided to speakers.
